The scale fixture now holds solid, 2 mm shell and declared bodies each bare and under scale("2"); otherwise N41p1-01 step 7 has no bare twin to take its ratios from. The M1 script called frob sim estimate (BD-219, M2, unreachable) and frob sim run @fixture:rank-agreement-b without --key, with no registered fixture form and no scope citation; it now drives synthetic arms through N36-20's frob-launch with --scope.
